scope: Pinned actual ATAPI dump address path; static findings are not runtime proof.
static_conclusion: Writer adds a 64-bit partition offset to the 64-bit volume offset and divides by sector size, constructs a four-byte big-endian CDB LBA, then directly calls RVA27fe. Its LBA path masks the top byte to four bits at RVA28e7, writes three remaining address bytes and selects the command from per-device offset90d. No large-LBA alternate dispatch exists at the direct call. Runtime registers and the selected command still require the new diagnostic.
